exposure: history of prior PTB or STL
cohort: A total of 126 pregnant women who underwent history-indicated cervical cerclage (53 laparoscopic and 73 transvaginal) were included in this study.
finding: Laparoscopic cervical cerclage may be more effective in preventing premature delivery before 34 weeks of gestation, and its influence on delivery gestational weeks was not affected by related medical history.
